items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Piton and them was a brother... He was a good player.

ctx.x: Well we used to have another, another trumpet player too, but that's, uh, Piton and them was a brother. Called him Sammy, Sammy Robins. Sammy, that's the brother. Sammy all over. Yeah, Sammy Albers, yeah. He was a good player. Too much all over him. But he didn't know much music, but he was a good player, a good kick song. The most of the friends I knew of music, Dijon, he was the one, he teached the whole band. Yeah, he teach the whole band.
Yeah. Did you have any teacher when you first started music?
